brief: Performs the :RevokeCapability action of a response plan by cutting an actor's paths to the effectful capability in a security graph.
detail: The graph is what audits and incidents ask, the live actor is what the runtime gates ask, so the responder cuts both: the graph edges, and the effectful kind of each registered live actor of the same name. Register live actors one at a time with AddLiveActor, because an object placed in a list literal is copied and revoking a copy changes nothing. It answers no other verb: each of those raises an error that names the responder to wire. Other actors that use the same tool keep their capability.
